notes.content: Students are required to complete a second major to develop a deeper understanding of at least one subject area. Students are encouraged to select a subject area that could provide flexibility for a student to also earn a single subject area credential to teach at the high school level in addition to the multiple subject teaching credential or to open a pathway into a second profession or graduate study. Common second majors include Art, English, History, Math, Spanish, Communication Sciences and Disorders, Environmental Science, Music, Psychology, and Race and Ethnic Studies. The following are the LOWER DIVISION REQUIREMENTS for this major. Please visit the catalog for all requirements for Liberal Studies for Education, B.A.
